text.aria-label: Title text 'A solar-shaped transfer is hard for RO-NC and the end rule to follow, but the pair alarm finds it from first light'
text.tspan: A solar-shaped transfer is hard for RO-NC and the end rule to follow,
but the pair alarm finds it from first light

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each dot: mean difference from a transfer of the same mean MW at a constant rate, on the 611 simulated transfers that start in even months. Line: interval from resampling whole months, corrected for nine contrasts. Dashed line: no difference. Rows marked first light score a solar-shaped transfer from sunrise instead of the drawn onset.'
text.tspan: Each dot: mean difference from a transfer of the same mean MW at a constant
rate, on the 611 simulated transfers that start in even months. Line: interval
from resampling whole months, corrected for nine contrasts. Dashed line: no
difference. Rows marked first light score a solar-shaped transfer from sunrise
